title: A step that changes a role's duty changes its role text
why: The role texts went stale because a ruling or step that changes a role's duty never has to touch its role text. Owner's goal: accurate at the fastest speed (owner 13:13 CST Nov 10).
note: When a step that names a role (coordinator, triage, batch runner, lane) goes done, its PR also changes that role's text in skills/project-ops, or its body says 'no role text change'. A check reads it. Red first. Builds after role-texts-match-rulings.
